WITH ranked AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id,
        sumsales,
        rk
    FROM (
        SELECT
            i_category,
            i_class,
            i_brand,
            i_product_name,
            d_year,
            d_qoy,
            d_moy,
            s_store_id,
            sumsales,
            RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
        FROM (
            SELECT
                it.i_category,
                it.i_class,
                it.i_brand,
                it.i_product_name,
                dd.d_year,
                dd.d_qoy,
                dd.d_moy,
                st.s_store_id,
                SUM(
                    CASE WHEN ss.ss_sales_price IS NULL OR ss.ss_quantity IS NULL
                         THEN 0
                         ELSE ss.ss_sales_price * ss.ss_quantity
                    END
                ) AS sumsales
            FROM store_sales AS ss
            JOIN (
                SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy
                FROM date_dim
                WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
            ) AS dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
            JOIN (
                SELECT s_store_sk, s_store_id
                FROM store
            ) AS st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
            JOIN (
                SELECT i_item_sk, i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name
                FROM item
            ) AS it ON ss.ss_item_sk = it.i_item_sk
            GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
                (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id),
                (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy),
                (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy),
                (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year),
                (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name),
                (i_category, i_class, i_brand),
                (i_category, i_class),
                (i_category),
                ()
            )
        ) AS sales_data
    ) AS ranked_inner
    WHERE rk <= 100
    ORDER BY
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id,
        sumsales,
        rk
    LIMIT 100
)
